description: This file implements a message queue interface using System V IPC mechanisms, including functions for generating queue keys, creating, sending, and receiving messages, and managing message queue lifecycle.

classes.name: SysVMessageQueue
classes.description: A class encapsulating a System V message queue, managing its creation, destruction, and message passing operations.

methods.name: GenerateQueueKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for the message queue based on a string input, using a hash function.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Create
methods.description: Creates or opens an existing message queue identified by a name, returning a unique pointer to the queue object.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the message queue, with options for blocking or non-blocking operation.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Receive
methods.description: Receives a message from the message queue, with support for message type filtering and blocking behavior.
